Container.Name: Agentforge
Container.Overview: Self-hosted vibecoding platform: run Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cline, Kilo Code, Gemini CLI and more in a single web UI. Every project gets its own isolated workspace container with terminal, editor, live preview, GitHub integration and project management.[br][br] [b]Setup:[/b] set HOST_DATA_PATH to exactly the same host path as AppData and set a long random Secret Key. The first-run setup token is printed to the container log and written to AppData/setup-token.txt.[br][br] [b]Note:[/b] Agentforge needs the Docker socket to create workspace containers (equivalent to root on the host). Only expose it behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS.
Container.Requires: HOST_DATA_PATH must equal the AppData host path. The workspace image (several GB) is pulled automatically on first project creation.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port of the Agentforge web interface.

Config.Name: Preview Ports
Config.Description: Port range for live previews of dev servers running in workspaces (PREVIEW_MODE=port). Host and container range must be identical.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database, project files, agent logins and caches.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Required to create and manage workspace containers.

Config.Name: HOST_DATA_PATH
Config.Description: MUST be identical to the host path of AppData above (workspace containers bind-mount subfolders of it). Prefer /mnt/cache/... or /mnt/user/... consistently.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Long random string used to encrypt stored API keys and tokens (e.g. output of: openssl rand -hex 32). Keep a copy - without it stored secrets cannot be decrypted. Do not change it later.

Config.Name: Workspace Image
Config.Description: Image used for project workspaces. Update it in Settings - System, then use 'Neu erstellen' per project.

Config.Name: Workspace Idle Stop (min)
Config.Description: Stop a workspace after this many minutes without running agents or terminal processes (0 = off). Can be overridden in Settings - System.

Config.Name: Preview Mode
Config.Description: port = previews on the Preview Ports range (no DNS needed); subdomain = previews on https://p[N].PREVIEW_DOMAIN through the main port (needs wildcard DNS + reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Preview Domain
Config.Description: Only for PREVIEW_MODE=subdomain, e.g. preview.example.com (wildcard *.preview.example.com must point to the reverse proxy).

Config.Name: GitHub OAuth Client ID
Config.Description: Optional: client id of your own GitHub OAuth App (device flow enabled) for the GitHub login.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set to 1 when Agentforge is only reached via HTTPS (reverse proxy).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID owning project files inside workspaces.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID owning project files inside workspaces.
